verdict.rationale: A live probe confirms https://docs.checkhq.com/llms.txt returns HTTP 200 with a structured index of Check's API docs, which links to topical pages. Doc pages are also served as raw markdown (.md URLs), so an agent can ingest them directly. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of agents consuming these docs, and no evidence of a fuller companion file such as llms-full.txt.
